verdict.rationale: Cekura publishes an API reference with concrete endpoints, such as sending call logs and creating project-level API keys. A probe confirmed a live OpenAPI spec at docs.cekura.ai/openapi.json, and SDK clients for programmatic access are also documented. missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration of driving the full product through the API (the one community comment describes users' own agents lacking APIs, not Cekura's API).

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can drive the product through a documented public API

citations.quote: PROBE openapi: HTTP 200 at https://docs.cekura.ai/openapi.json — contains "openapi" key

Your agent (or its provider's post-call webhook) POSTs here with the transcript, recording URL, and metadata; Cekura stores it as a `CallLog`, schedules metric evaluation, and surfaces it in Observability.
Create a new API key. When using API key authentication, only project-level API keys can be created.
Programmatic access to Cekura — sync and async clients for application code
